bug.actual_behavior: The archive extracts to a nested pandoc-version directory while discovery checks the parent layout, so the wrapper exits with pandoc binary not found after installation.
evidence: Wrapper error: pandoc binary not found after installation; executable exists under nested version/version/pandoc.exe.
bug.expected_behavior: After downloading and extracting Pandoc, the wrapper should discover pandoc.exe and continue rendering.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py for an Rmd on Windows with no Pandoc on PATH.
Inspect the bootstrap directory and observe pandoc.exe one version directory deeper than the path used for discovery.
bug.summary: Windows Pandoc bootstrap extracts an extra nested version directory and then fails discovery
bug.workaround: Prepend the actual nested executable directory to PATH and set RSTUDIO_PANDOC before rerunning with no install.
